{
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "confidence": 0.6,
  "anomalies": [
    {
      "category": "wrong_component_type",
      "components": ["U8"],
      "pins": ["U8.1"],
      "nets": ["+3.3V"],
      "observed": "PCA9685PW address pin A0 (U8 pin 1) is tied to the +3.3V net, while A1 through A5 (pins 2, 3, 4, 5, 24) are tied to GND. The PCA9685 is therefore strapped to address 0x41, not 0x40.",
      "expected": "The specification lists the PCA9685PW I2C address as 0x40, which requires A0 to be tied to GND like the other address pins.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"U8\") (pin \"1\") (pinfunction \"A0\") (pintype \"input\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"U8\") (pin \"2\") (pinfunction \"A1\") (pintype \"input\"))"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40"}
      ],
      "impact": "The FCC will not be able to address the PWM driver at 0x40, so servo/PWM outputs will not be controlled as designed.",
      "confidence": 0.6
    },
    {
      "category": "bridged_nets",
      "components": ["REG3", "U5", "U8", "U13", "U19", "GPS_NAVC2", "R17", "R8"],
      "pins": ["REG3.1", "U5.8", "GPS_NAVC2.1", "R8.1"],
      "nets": ["+3.3V", "+3V3"],
      "observed": "The LD39200 3.3 V regulator output (REG3 pin 1) and the sensor/peripheral supply pins sit on net '+3.3V', while the MCU-side decoupling, I2C pull-ups and the GPS connector supply pin sit on a separate net '+3V3'. The two nets are never joined in the netlist and each has its own SPICE source.",
      "expected": "The specification says the 3V3 rail feeds both MCUs, all I2C sensors and the peripherals. This requires one continuous 3.3 V net.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"1\") (name \"+3.3V\") (class \"Default\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"2\") (name \"+3V3\") (class \"Default\")"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs"}
      ],
      "impact": "If the two nets are really isolated, the MCUs, pull-ups and GPS connector would have no supply from the regulator, or the sensors would be unpowered. The likely cause is a net-label mismatch, which is hard to confirm from the netlist alone.",
      "confidence": 0.3
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The PCA9685 address strap ties A0 to the 3.3 V rail while the specification requires address 0x40, which is a clear deviation that would stop the FCC from reaching the PWM driver. A second, lower-confidence concern is that the 3.3 V regulator output and the MCU/peripheral 3.3 V are on two unconnected net names."
}
